title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje tek Ish Parku i Autobusave, Ne Rrugen Kongresi i Lushnjes - Tirane (ID D8142Z-3)
description_sq:
Ne Rrugen Kongresi i Lushnjes (paralele e Rruges se Kavajes), Shitet Apartment 2+1, me siperfaqe 75 m².
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 3-te te nje pallati ekzistues (parafabrikat-me shtrese termoizolimi te brendshme).
Organizohet ne ambient ndenjeje, korridor shperndares, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet (me dritare) dhe ballkon.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto. Eshte rinovuar teresisht ne 2022, me shtrese termoizolimi te brendshme, te gjitha dritaret plastike me xhama triplex,
parket, rifinitura te mureve, rinovuar rrjeti elektrik, hidraulik dhe tualeti.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara per banim, e njohur per qetesine dhe infrastrukturen e zhvilluar. Vetem 50 metra larg cerdhes, kopshtit dhe shkollave publike – zgjedhje ideale per familje.
Disponon certifikate pronesie (Me Hipoteke)
Cmimi i shitjes: 16 500 000 ALL (165 milione leke te vjetra).
//*sapo eshte ulur cmimi nga 185 milione
Shitet dhe me kredi.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at the former Bus Park, on Kongressi i Lushnje Street - Tirana (ID D8142Z-3)
description_en: On Kongresi i Lushnje Street (parallel to Kavaje Street), 2+1 Apartment for sale, with an area of ​​75 m². The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building (prefabricated - with internal thermal insulation layer). It is organized in living room, distribution corridor, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom (with window) and balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo. It was completely renovated in 2022, with an internal thermal insulation layer, all plastic windows with triplex glass, parquet, refinished walls, renewed electrical network, plumbing and toilet. The apartment is located in one of the most sought-after residential areas, known for its tranquility and developed infrastructure. Only 50 meters from the nursery, kindergarten and public schools - an ideal choice for families. It has a certificate of ownership (with mortgage) Selling price: 16,500,000 ALL (165 million old lek). //*the price has just been reduced from 185 million. For sale and on credit.
